articles.title: Tether's U.S.-focused stablecoin grows over 500% in a month, but still lags main rivals
articles.snippet: USAT's market cap jumped above $140 million in April, though it remains well behind Circle's USDC, PayPal's PYUSD and Ripple's RLUSD tokens.

articles.title: What's next as hot money cycle has gone from crypto to gold to AI to memory
articles.snippet: As bitcoin and gold momentum fades, investor flows are increasingly rotating into AI infrastructure, semiconductor and memory-related equities.

articles.title: Crypto companies have tightened compliance, but gaps remain: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: Around 47% of crypto organizations onboarded in 2026 are operating at alerting standards that would have ranked among the industry’s strictest five years ago.

articles.title: Crypto card monthly transaction volume surges 230% from 2025
articles.snippet: Payment volume on crypto-linked credit and debit cards has been steadily increasing since 2024, reaching about $7.8 billion in cumulative transactions this month.

articles.title: Huawei's New Benchmark Gives AI Agents Months of Your Life—Then Watches Them Fail
articles.snippet: Claw-Anything simulates a real digital existence and asks AI assistants to handle it. GPT-5.5, the best model available, scored 34.5%.
